name: @xmoon76/pi-tui
description: Terminal User Interface library with differential rendering for efficient text-based applications (vendored fork of @earendil-works/pi-tui, see UPSTREAM.json)
author: Mario Zechner

repository.note: vendored snapshot of @earendil-works/pi-tui at v0.84.4 (see UPSTREAM.json); carries the structured local divergence ledger in packages/pi-tui/vendor-divergences.json and its generated DIVERGENCES.md report (re-verify all on every re-vendor)

//native: native/ (darwin/win32 modifier-key prebuilds) is deliberately not vendored. Without it the TUI still runs, but platform input degrades: on Windows/Apple Terminal Shift+Tab is indistinguishable from Tab and the native Shift+Enter modifier fallback is unavailable (terminal.ts falls back to sequence heuristics). Supported surface: Linux/WSL/SSH into Linux. See AGENTS.md.
